title: Naning War
text: The Naning War, also known as the Naning Conflict or Naning Revolt, was a conflict in the region surrounding Malacca, which was part of the Straits Settlements under British control. The conflict was fought between British East India Company (EIC), which had taken over Malacca and its neighbouring areas from the Dutch in 1824, against the Malay chiefdom of Naning, located adjacent to Malacca.
